requirements.description: Six-deck Red Dog supports consecutive-card pushes, opening-pair handling, spread decisions, and the approved spread and pair payout schedule.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #84; focused tests cover spread payouts, consecutive pushes, pair returns, three-of-a-kind, call, and matching raise paths.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Red Dog state, active decisions, recent rounds, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Normal-user session context overrides caller-supplied player ids, and terminal Red Dog history survives backend restart.

requirements.description: Red Dog ante, optional matching raise, push return, and payout movements use the shared ledger exactly once under stable action identifiers.
requirements.notes: Game code never mutates balances directly; replay proof matches immutable Red Dog command fingerprints and verifies complete prepared-versus-committed settlement.

requirements.description: The Red Dog surface provides complete English and Russian copy and remains responsive, accessible, and timer-clean across required desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.
requirements.notes: Acceptance evidence covers both locales, all four named viewports, spread decisions, automatic pair and consecutive states, third-card settlement, and canonical route restoration.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery automatically include Red Dog with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 110 and the normalized tests.game_drivers.red_dog:play driver reference released by issue #77.
